speaker: Game Hunter

You come back here once that's settled, and we'll have a look at you. / Ah, it's you. I think I told you before, but we're looking for sharp-taloned birds of prey, not spring chickens. You can hear all the tall tales you like about a fellow, but the true test of a hunter comes here, in the bush. That's right, a test. If you can accomplish the task I shall lay before you, I'll let you into our little Hunt Club. Venture out into the bush, hunt down the game that I assign you, come back, and I'll tell you more. So, are you a bird of prey? Or a chicken? (choices: I'm a bird of prey. / I'll get back to you.) / Right! Now the game I want you to hunt is called a thalassinon. Normally, I'd have you out in the bush, searching for yourself... But since this is your first time out, and we happen to know where one is, I'll make it easy for you. He's close, on the Vaddu Strand. Now, your game is what we call rare. You can't expect to just walk out and find 'em all over. No, you've got to know how to flush 'em out, and that isn't always easy. Listen now: the thalassinon can only be spotted from a good elevation. Even if you don't see him at first, you pick your spot, and keep looking. Dispatch him, and he'll drop a Shelled Trophy. You bring that to me. Now, I've gone a bit out of my way to explain things for you, but the hard part's up to you: the hunt! Find your game, hunt him well, and bring back that Shelled Trophy. Me? I'll be here, awaiting the good word. Good hunting! / Suit yourself. Some people can live their lives never knowing the thrill of the hunt, and they're content with that...poor sods. / Ah, I was waiting! Good, good. I believe you've passed the test. Welcome to the Hunt Club! Now, for your next task... I know! Why don't you have a word with the three bangaa brothers over there. Good hunting! / Dispatch the thalassinon you'll find out on the Vaddu Strand of the Phon Coast, and he'll drop a Shelled Trophy, which you'll bring to me. Remember, you'll need to choose a vantage point with good elevation if you want to find him. Pick your spot and stay there till he shows himself. / If you're ready for more, go and talk to the three bangaa brothers over there. They're a bit shifty in a pinch, but they won't lead you astray. / Hrm? Legs go weak on you? Don't worry, just because you're on a hunt, it doesn't mean you have to rush to it before you're ready. / How goes the hunt? Ah, yes, I've been keeping track of the trophies you've handed in to the bangaa brothers three. Let's see... [value] to , [value] to , and [value] to Anything else you'd like to know about? (choices: Tell me about rare game. / Tell me about the Hunt Club. / No, thanks.) / Rare game are a tricky lot indeed! They're not just lying around waiting to be found, you see... They're not just lying around waiting to be found, you see... Take, for example, the thalassinon I had you hunt. There're plenty like him that can only be spotted once you've found the right spot. / Rare game are a tricky lot indeed! They're not just lying around waiting to be found, you see... Some game, they're fickle creatures. As like to be in a spot as not. But don't worry, you do your legwork, and you'll find 'em eventually. / Rare game are a tricky lot indeed! They're not just lying around waiting to be found, you see... Some game, they only show up at certain times of day. It's instinctive behavior. But don't fret, a good hunter has instincts of his own! / Rare game are a tricky lot indeed! They're not just lying around waiting to be found, you see... Sometimes, you have to kill a few fiends in a particular area before the game you seek shows itself. Sometimes not even that's enough. / Rare game are a tricky lot indeed! They're not just lying around waiting to be found, you see... More oft than not, you won't even know where to start looking! That's when your fellow hunters come in handy. Most of the lot here're just looking for regular marks, but some of them might have heard reports of rare game on their travels. Ask around. / The Hunt Club isn't just for sport, you know. When rare game is spotted on a rampage, we're the only thing between it and its next victim. While your average mark is posted after the damage has been done, we like to hunt down game before lives are lost. Thankless work, but it matters. Luckily for us, we've found patrons in Archades with an eye for what we do, and the interest to support it. In fact, they wager on our hunts. The wager is simple: they pick a favorite hunter, and should he fell the most game, they win. You're a guest here, so they'll not wager on you. For you, we have a different contest in store. Now, when you hunt rare game, be sure to bring a trophy back to us. The question is, to which of the bangaa brothers three will you give it? That's our little wager. Ah, I suppose I should tell you, we've worked out a system to avoid getting too much of one thing in the Outfitters. See, we split things up... Think well before turning in your trophies: what's available at the Outfitters depends on how many you bring in, and who you give them to. / Well, it seems you've felled all the rare game out there! Let's have a look, shall we. Step right this way... / Your successes have been recognized, the winner's been announced, and my work here with you is done. I'll be here still, though, never you fear. Feel free to drop by if you're ever in need of company!

That's something to be proud of. / You're awful young-lookin' to be a hunter... or are you just travelin', maybe? This coast may look pretty, but the men who come here, they're here for the hunt. If it is huntin' you're after, you might talk to some of 'em. Might learn somethin' of value, you never know. / You want to live a long life as a hunter, you've got to know your limits. speaker: Helpful Hunter
line_text: Perhaps you weren't aware, but should you leave this camp to the northeast, you'll find yourself shortly in the Tchita Uplands. We'll soon be traveling that way ourselves, then east on to Balfonheim.

speaker: Cheery Hunter
line_text: When I first heard of a camp filled with hunters, well, I imagined the worst. How surprised I was to find it quite pleasant!

speaker: Proud Hunter; Game Hunter
line_text: You seem like the adventurous sort, so I'll tell you something interesting: to the north of Tchita Uplands, there is an ancient ruin... Everyone's talking about the fiends there... rather dangerous, by the sound of it. I say, if they're so concerned, shouldn't they go and hunt the fiends themselves!? I mean, they are hunters, aren't they! / So this is the Hunter Camp! At last... How long I've dreamt of seeing this place!

Apparently, it's some moneyed gentry in Archades funding them, too. Ah, details, details, I can't write anything without more details!

line_text: Haa? What is that? This key you carry, I have seen its like somewhere before... Why, yes! It is a key to Site 11! Wait...how did I know that? I do not even know what "Site 11" means! Hanta... / Svagat...er, welcome to the Hunter Camp, traveler. I...am not a hunter myself, I do not think. I fell from a skycity, you see, and have forgotten everything from before the fall... I do not even know my own name, bhadra! / I fell from a skycity, you see, and have forgotten everything from before the fall... I do not even know my own name, bhadra! Slowly, slowly, I am saving up my coin. Even should my memory not return, I will go back to Bhujerba some day. This, I swear.

speaker: Game Hunter
line_text: To make her happy, that's why I've come here... Happy! While I waste away my days as what? A hunter!? Here, in this place? (sigh)

speaker: Concerned Hunter
line_text: I hear the nasties up Sochen way have been dealt with...but it weren't no hunter from this camp that did 'em in! Speaking of which, the hunting sortie that went up there never came back, did they. Hope they didn't get lost...or worse. / I hear some hunters have gone up Sochen way to do battle with some nasties that think they own the place... I wish 'em luck! If what I've heard is true, they're going to need their fair share of it! / Used to the camp yet? If you still can't find your way around, go and talk to the moogle on the hill. When it comes to cartography, he's your man...er, moogle.

speaker: Game Hunter
line_text: I hear the moneyed folk up in Archades have taken to boastin' about hunters...and wagerin' on 'em. Each of 'em tries to pick the best hunter to sponsor... How can that possibly be fun? What are we, racin' chocobos? / This fellow here, he fell down from Bhujerba! Reckon it's true what they say, that even if you fall from a skycity, you won't die... Though, just between you and me, I'm not eager to test that theory out for meself, if you take my meanin'.

speaker: Game Hunter
line_text: I heard those nasties up in Sochen got what was coming to them. Guess some hunter was worth his salt, eh? / Those red bangaa over there are talking about going to Archades on foot, I hear. Now, if you go from the Tchita Uplands through Sochen Cave Palace, you can reach Archades, all right. But the fiends in Sochen are a nasty lot. A group of hunters just left to do something about that I hear... I wish 'em luck! / Look, just because you think you know something about a mark doesn't mean you can rest easy. You have to keep your ears open and your eyes wide. Get as much information as you can, put it all together, then make your move.

speaker: Shifty-Eyed Man; Outfitters
line_text: There's nothing for you here, boy. Shopping the Outfitters is a privilege, see. / Hrmm? What're you looking at? Ah, so the Huntmaster's given you the nod, has he? Well, anyone that's right by him is right by me. Listen good, and I'll explain how the Outfitters works. When you bring trophies back for the bangaa brothers here, it pleases their patrons. The patrons send cash, doubtless a portion of their winnings from wagering, and the Huntmaster uses that to bring in goods to sell here. But, not everyone may buy. Only those to whom the Huntmaster has given permission. See, this here's an exclusive shop. Hunt Club only. That said, it sounds like you're here with his blessing, so, how may I help you? Care to see my wares? (choices: Check them out. / Leave.) / Greetings. How may I help you today? (choices: Show me your wares. / Just wanted to say hello.) / Ach, I'm sorry, friend. speaker: Game Hunter
line_text: Yours is a face I've not seen around these parts. You seem a bit young to be one of us...but you don't have the look of a wayfarer, either! All right, all right, enough being nosey... I'll keep to my own business. Heh. / If it's word on game you seek, this camp can't be beat. The folks here, they've hunted the world over, you see.

speaker: Hawker
line_text: I was supposed to meet my partner here, but honestly, I don't think he's coming. / Va'Kansa? Him and me were attacked by this horse- monster out in the Salikawood and got separated. I ran for safety, and happened to end up pretty close to the Phon Coast, which is where we were headed anyway. I waited for him a while... It makes sense to wait for him here, our destination, right? That's why I went on ahead. Come to think of it, I did see a posting for that horse-monster. That was him? Glad he made it! / Oh, by the way, our boss left a message for Va'Kansa. If you see him, pass it on for me, 'kay? "You're fired. Don't bother coming back." / Oh, by the way, our boss left a message for Va'Kansa. If you see him, pass it on for me, 'kay? "You're fired. Don't bother coming back." / I'm setting up the next trade deal, here. The folks 'round here want all kinds of bizarre things, I tell you.

speaker: Neophyte Hunter
line_text: We've come all the way here, and now our leader doesn't want to go into camp! Says he doesn't like crowds...but I think he's scared. Not that I don't understand. Hunters are a fearsome lot, even when you're one of 'em! / I'm scouting for word of marks for my hunting party...but, I have to wonder, exactly what sort of mark should we be going for? Anything too strong and we'll be picking the dirt out of our teeth...

actor: 通行止めバンガ・リムザット
speaker: Rimzat
line_text: Hha? Sorry, you have the wrong man. Yes, I have been to Rabanastre, but you are not familiar. A sandstorm in the Westersand? What's this about?

speaker: Cartographers' Guild
line_text: Leave it to me, kupo! I'll soon point you the right way! That's my job! First thing, there're five ways in and out of camp here. But worry not, they only go to two places: the Tchita Uplands and the Salikawood. Which way were you headed, kupo? (choices: Toward the Tchita Uplands. / Toward the Salikawood. / Actually, never mind.) / There are two ways out to the Tchita Uplands, kupo. One runs along the coast, and one cuts up through the hills. / If you plan on following the coast, you'll want to leave from the east side of the camp. / To go the other way, you'll want to head off to my left, kupo. That way leads to the hills! / Don't worry, no matter which way you take, you'll end up in the Tchita Uplands, kupo, guaranteed! / Got that, kupo? You just come to me any time you're feeling lost! This camp can be a confusing place, kupo! / There are three ways to the Salikawood, kupo! Two of them go by the sea, and one goes through the hills. / To go the first way, head over to the southeast side of camp and follow the road up that rocky slope, kupo. That leads to the coast road! / The other two ways are to my right, kupo. Go down the hill, and you'll soon be on the coast road. Stay higher up, and you'll reach the hills. / Don't worry, no matter which way you take, you'll end up at the Salikawood, kupo! That said, the hill road is a touch shorter.

speaker: Viera Wayfarer
line_text: There is good beyond the Wood, yet all is not so. Still, I feel I was right to leave. I shall go east from here, to the port town of Balfonheim. I have heard it is a place where men and women value freedom above all else. / Where do you go, wayfarer? To the east lie the Tchita Uplands. To the north, across the plains, lies the seat of empire, Archades. Myself, I shall go east, to the port town of Balfonheim. I have heard it is a place where men and women value freedom above all else. / What's this? To meet another viera, here... You, too, have left the Wood? I have left, for I desired freedom. Had I remained, I would have surely perished. You see, freedom to me is like the air itself. Yet, I did not think my little sister would follow. She would not listen to me, and now I fear I may have erred in allowing her to come. / Where do you go, wayfarer? To the east lie the Tchita Uplands. To the north, across the plains, lies the seat of empire, Archades. Myself, I shall go east, to the port town of Balfonheim. I have heard it is a place where men and women value freedom above all else.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: It would seem we made the right choice. / If we'd taken the easy way and come by airship... / one of those patrols would no doubt have been quick to roll out the red carpet.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: We're on the Empire's doorstep now, so we shouldn't have to worry quite so much... / but that's no excuse to get sloppy.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: It is still a long road to the capital.

line_text: Why the capital?

speaker: no name shown
line_text: The nethicite. I must destroy it. / Are you sure? You don't want it for yourself?

speaker: Balthier
line_text: Use its power to restore Dalmasca— something like that? / The best intentions invite the worst kind of trouble.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: Lusting for ever greater power, blinded by the nethicite. / Is that how you see me?

speaker: Balthier
line_text: That does sound like someone I know.

speaker: Balthier; no name shown
line_text: He was obsessed with nethicite. It was all he cared about. / He'd babble nonsense, blind to aught but the Stone's power. / He'd talk about some 'Eynah,' or was it 'Venat'? No matter. / Everything he did, he did to get closer to the nethicite, to understand it. / He made airships, weapons... / He even made me a Judge.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: You were a...a Judge!?

speaker: no name shown
line_text: Part of a past I'd rather forget. / It didn't last long. I ran. I left the Judges...and him.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: Cidolfus Demen Bunansa. / Draklor Laboratory's very own Doctor Cid. / That's when he lost his heart to nethicite, lost himself.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: And I suppose that's when I lost my father.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: Don't follow in his footsteps.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: I ran away. / I couldn't stand seeing him like that, a slave to the Stone. / So I ran. Free at last.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: Funny I went for the Dusk Shard. How could I have known that it was nethicite? / And then, of course, I met you.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: All that running, and I got nowhere. / It's time to end this— cut my ties to the past.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: It's hard to leave the past behind. I know.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: The choice is yours to make. But don't give your heart to a stone. / You're too strong for that, Princess.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: I pray you're right, Balthier.
